title: Production Operations & SRE
intro: Production and SRE interviews test whether you've shipped and survived — the operational maturity round. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with SRE practices (the discipline — SLIs/SLOs, error budgets), then the incident lifecycle (management, response, on-call). Debugging production and performance troubleshooting are the core-mechanics tier, then root-cause analysis and postmortems (the learning loop). Runbooks, capacity planning, and the deep-debugging tier (memory leaks, thread/heap dumps) follow, with chaos engineering at the advanced tier. It closes with scenario-based questions.
